plan.name: Allow repositories without hand-ratified locks
plan.summary: Change TestTheRepositorysLocksRatifiedByHandHold and TestTheRepositorysHandLocksHold to report that the repository has no lock ratified by hand and pass when a Git checkout has none, replacing their current nonzero-count requirement. Keep checking every tracked hand-ratified lock, failing on invalid locks and read or enumeration errors, and preserve the existing skip outside a Git checkout (D-0208, D-0219, D-0226). Cover both repository checks with temporary Git fixtures containing hand-ratified locks and their proposal-specific journal ratifications, including rejection after a lock changes, so coverage survives amendments to the last real hand-ratified project; update the stale comments that assume particular projects remain hand-ratified. The merger records this test-policy refinement of D-0226; the existing ratification rules and current-state documentation remain accurate.

tests.name: TestCLIRepositoryHandLocksAllowNone
tests.says: The CLI repository test passes with an explanation when no tracked locks are hand-ratified, accepts fixture locks ratified for their exact proposals, still rejects changed or unreadable tracked locks, and keeps its skip outside a Git checkout.

tests.name: TestDecisionRepositoryHandLocksAllowNone
tests.says: The decisions repository test passes with an explanation when no tracked locks are hand-ratified, accepts fixture locks ratified for their exact proposals, still rejects changed or unreadable tracked locks, and keeps its skip outside a Git checkout.
